background_story: In the ancient constellation of Antlia, the Pump, a mystical being named Azrael was said to reside. Azrael was a gentle soul, tasked with the duty of pouring the celestial waters of life into the mortal realm. With each passing season, Azrael would carefully tend to the stars, ensuring the cosmos remained in balance. As the myth went, Azrael's presence was felt on earth whenever a new spring began, bringing forth the first tender shoots of life. The people of the land would offer prayers and gratitude to Azrael, seeking the blessing of fertile soil and abundant harvests. It was said that on quiet nights, one could hear the soft whisper of Azrael's waters flowing from the heavens, nourishing the world below.
